note: Retired site URLs that search engines still know, mapped to where their content lives now. build.mjs writes a noindex meta-refresh stub for each source (never listed in the sitemap); scripts/lib/redirects.mjs checks that no source is also built as a real page and that every target exists. A retired provider goes to its /not-free/#<id> section when data/not-free.json has one, otherwise to /not-free/#removed. A retired compare pair goes to /compare/?compare=a,b while both providers are listed, otherwise to /compare/.
